outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: a red's base measurement now goes through gate_in_background over the red run's steps (_evio.red_step_names). Past the bound, unmeasured, or under auto it is a new step dispatch-base (launch_base marks the start's baseMeasured mark with background/at/argv/memberTree, prints a run: line for the new CLI verb `drive-phase.py base-run <task> <manifest> --project-dir P`). base-run runs take_base -> measure_base with no bound (run_verb_bounded(..., None)) and writes the mark through fresh_keeper: it re-reads state on each write, and writes only while the mark is still its own launch (same `at`). The mark is written before the run (ran, pids incl. own pid and the base run's pid, tree), so sweep_base_trees (now through base_running) removes a killed run's tree. wait-base (base_waiting) holds while the run has not started or a pid may be alive; base_gate in gate_step short-cuts to the wait or to a task_gate repeat once the run ended, so the task gate is not launched again; base_reading_for returns (print, reading, unknown) and gate_red_decision decides from the mark (a `decided` flag, so it is read once). An inline base past BASE_MEASURE_SECONDS is handed to the background (mark keeps `cut`) instead of being read as not-knowable. New decision gate-red-base-unknown (options rerun|measure-base|block, block needs --reason; STEPS line+rule, SIGNAL_VERBS judge, DECISIONS, GATE_VERDICT_DECISIONS). It is reached when a measurable base run left no reading (tree not built, run failed or answered nothing, killed: cut_short), or its reading has no base run behind it (base_behind: run is None). A later red of the same start whose row has no base run behind it stops there too, so rerun never falls to the writer. measure-base (apply_answer) spends the start's mark. NO-BASE CHOICE: a red run HEAD has left (measurable False) keeps its meaning and goes to the writer: no base can be measured for it and the next gate runs at the new HEAD. A completed base run compared as `not-knowable` (it names a run, but its cases can't be charged) also keeps the writer path, as before. Treating it as unknown turned 20 existing cases red (dd1, sv1, ws3-ws16, bg3, wl5, wi1-wi6, au23 ...) on gates like `false`. The task's own definition of not knowable is no row, failed, or cut. gate_said/gate_wait_said refactored onto shared background_dispatch/background_wait, which base_said/base_wait_said use too.
